rev.t:
Booked the ground floor auditorium for a birthday party of 70 members, this review is with respect to that hall only (there are other halls on other floors)
Only members can book. Hall rate is very cheap ~ 7k or lesser. …
ECA- Excellently managed as always. Very comfortable location with good arrangements. Parking is the only problem here and always we have to park far away and walk down.
Great place for organising parties, KG school anniversaries. Very less parking. Location is good. Dining space available.
